_help: Names are first name + last initial ('Ava K.') or a handle ('pixelwiz'). Never full names, never emails. Never type a rank: the site sorts by points, and ties share a rank. Keep members alphabetical so two people's edits land on different lines. When you change points, also set updated to today's date (YYYY-MM-DD). Badge colors: neon, cyan, purple, gold, coral. Every change to this file needs a club leader's approval.
